nodes.klein: to rebel, revolt. (Aram.-Syr. מְרַד (= he rebelled, revolted), Arab. marada (= he was bold in rebellion), OSArab. מרד (= rebellion, war), Ethiop. marada (= he ran strenuously, attacked), marād (= rebellion).] he rebelled, revolted; it ran (said of a wound). he caused to rebel, incited. was induced to rebel, was incited. he rebelled, revolted.
